BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to commercial janitorial services; creating a newsection; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By December 1, 2014, the department oflabor and industries shall report to the appropriate committees of thelegislature any recommendations for legislation or rule makingaddressing workload and safety standards for employees of commercialjanitorial services. (2) In developing recommendations, the department must consult withrepresentatives from the business and labor communities, includingcommercial janitorial services businesses, labor unions, and otherinterested organizations or entities the department determines areappropriate. The recommendations may not supersede local collectivebargaining agreements. (3) This section expires January 31, 2015.
